text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hold up!
There's a bunch of monsters swarming about here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな待って！　
このへんに魔物が集まってきてる！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Dealing with regular monsters on top of all this won't be easy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物も倒しながら、
鏡餅も倒さなきゃいけないんだね……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
It won't, but we'll defeat them nonetheless.
Keep your guard up and press on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物だろうとなんだろうと、
立ちはだかるなら倒すまでだ。
気を引き締めていこう！
